sql: SELECT "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" AS k, (CAST("roller_coaster"."Height" AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Length") AS m1 FROM "roller_coaster" WHERE (CAST("roller_coaster"."Height" AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Length") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: roller_coaster.coaster height relative to track length
why: coaster height / track length: a ratio of two quantities in m
rank roller_coaster rows by coaster height relative to track length

sql: SELECT "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" AS k, (CAST("roller_coaster"."Length" AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Height") AS m1 FROM "roller_coaster" WHERE (CAST("roller_coaster"."Length" AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Height") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" AS k, ("roller_coaster"."Height" - "roller_coaster"."Length") AS m1 FROM "roller_coaster" WHERE ("roller_coaster"."Height" - "roller_coaster"."Length") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: coaster height - track length: both in m and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one roller coaster

sql: SELECT "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" AS k, (CAST(("roller_coaster"."Height" - "roller_coaster"."Length") AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Length") AS m1 FROM "roller_coaster" WHERE (CAST(("roller_coaster"."Height" - "roller_coaster"."Length") AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Length") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
